subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in silent STT history enrichment for unmentioned audio in requireMention Discord channels, and should it be Discord-only or a shared channel contract?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but retaining unmentioned speech changes privacy/security expectations and adds configuration surface that repository policy treats as a maintainer-owned product decision.

options.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
options.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract for silent audio transcription and implement Discord as the first supported channel with security/provenance tests.

options.title: Discord-only option
options.body: Add a narrow Discord guild/channel option first, accepting later migration risk if Matrix, WhatsApp, Signal, or other channels need the same contract.

options.title: Decline silent retention
options.body: Keep mention-gated Discord behavior as-is and document that unmentioned audio is not transcribed into later history.

recommendation.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
recommendation.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract for silent audio transcription and implement Discord as the first supported channel with security/provenance tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main work owns the exact Discord preflight/history/config files where the product decision would land first.
